# VidCruiter

> > VidCruiter is an industry-leading video recruiting platform that combines AI-powered video interviewing, applicant tracking, and structured assessment tools to streamline talent identification and hiring.

VidCruiter provides a comprehensive recruitment automation suite designed for enterprise hiring teams. The platform integrates pre-recorded and live video interviewing, intelligent scheduling, fraud detection, skills assessment, and reference checking into a unified system that reduces time-to-hire and improves hiring quality through structured, bias-reducing processes.

## Key Topics

- Video Interviewing
- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- Recruitment Automation
- Structured Interviewing
- AI Interview Intelligence
- Candidate Screening
- Interview Scheduling
- Fraud Detection
- Skills Assessment
- DEIA (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging)
- Bias Reduction
- Interview Management
- Reference Checking
- Hiring Compliance
- Candidate Experience

## Video Interviewing & Live Interviews

- [Pre-Recorded Video Interviews | VidCruiter](https://vidcruiter.com/video-interviewing/pre-recorded): Pre-recorded one-way video interviews for cost-effective candidate screening with AI.
- [Live Video Interviews | VidCruiter](https://vidcruiter.com/video-interviewing/live): Live video conferencing platform for recruiting with built-in rating tools.
- [VidCruiter Support - Have you Encountered a Technical Problem?](https://vidcruiter.com/video-interviewing/applicant-support): 24/7 applicant support for technical issues during video interviews.

## Interview Management & Scheduling

- [VidCruiter's Interview Management System](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/management-system): Unified platform for planning, scheduling, conducting and assessing interviews.
- [Advanced Interview Scheduling Software for the Enterprise Environment.](https://vidcruiter.com/interview-scheduling/software): Automated interview scheduling with calendar integration and candidate notifications.
- [Digital Structured Interview Software | VidCruiter](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/structured/platform): Structured interviewing platform reducing bias and increasing predictive validity.

## AI-Powered Interview Intelligence

- [Summarize and Create Interview Transcripts with AI](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/ai-interview-notes): AI-powered automated note-taking and transcription for objective hiring decisions.
- [Stop Fake Candidates with Advanced AI Fraud Detection](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/fraud-detection): AI-powered fraud detection preventing deepfakes and candidate verification.
- [AI Automated Interview Guides for Recruiters](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/automated-interview-guides): AI-generated interview guides, scorecards and rating rubrics reducing admin work.
- [Interview Intelligence 101: How to Improve Your Interview Process Using AI](https://vidcruiter.com/interview/intelligence): Guide on using AI-powered interview intelligence to optimize hiring processes.
